36:3.en: Lo! thou art of those sent

36:5.en: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful

36:6.ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمࣰ ا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
36:6.en: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless

36:7.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:7.en: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not

36:8.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
36:8.en: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked

36:9.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
36:9.en: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not

36:10.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:10.en: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not

36:11.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَأَجۡرࣲ كَرِيمٍ
36:11.en: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward

36:12.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:12.en: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register)

36:13.ar: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:13.en: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them

36:14.ar: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
36:14.en: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you

36:15.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
36:15.en: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie

36:16.ar: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:16.en: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you

36:17.en: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message)

36:18.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
36:18.en: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands

36:19.ar: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
36:19.en: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk

36:20.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
36:20.en: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent

36:21.ar: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
36:21.en: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided

36:22.ar: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:22.en: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back

36:23.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
36:23.en: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save

36:24.ar: إِنِّيٓ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
36:24.en: Then truly I should be in error manifest

36:25.en: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me

36:26.ar: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:26.en: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

36:27.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
36:27.en: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones

36:28.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
36:28.en: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send

36:29.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
36:29.en: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct

36:30.ar: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
36:30.en: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

36:31.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:31.en: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them

36:32.ar: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:32.en: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us

36:33.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبࣰّ ا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:33.en: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof

36:34.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
36:34.en: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein

36:35.ar: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:35.en: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks

36:36.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:36.en: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

36:37.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
36:37.en: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness

36:38.ar: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
36:38.en: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise

36:39.ar: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
36:39.en: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf

36:40.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
36:40.en: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit

36:41.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
36:41.en: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship

36:42.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
36:42.en: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride

36:43.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
36:43.en: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved

36:44.ar: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
36:44.en: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while

36:45.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
36:45.en: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless)

36:46.ar: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةࣲ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
36:46.en: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it

36:47.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:47.en: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest

36:48.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
36:48.en: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful

36:49.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
36:49.en: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing

36:50.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:50.en: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk

36:51.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
36:51.en: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord

36:52.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:52.en: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth

36:53.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:53.en: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us

36:54.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
36:54.en: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do

36:55.ar: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
36:55.en: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed

36:56.ar: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
36:56.en: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining

36:57.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
36:57.en: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask

36:58.ar: سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبࣲّ رَّحِيمࣲ‏
36:58.en: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace

36:59.en: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day

36:60.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:60.en: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe

36:61.en: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path

37:1.en: By those who set the ranks in battle order

37:2.en: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

37:3.en: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder

37:4.en: Lo! thy Lord is surely One

37:5.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
37:5.en: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings

37:6.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
37:6.en: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets

37:7.ar: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
37:7.en: With security from every froward devil

37:8.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
37:8.en: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side

37:9.en: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment

37:10.ar: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
37:10.en: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame

37:11.ar: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
37:11.en: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay

37:12.en: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

37:13.en: And heed not when they are reminded

37:14.en: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent

37:15.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
37:15.en: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic

37:16.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
37:16.en: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)

37:18.en: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low

37:19.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
37:19.en: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold

37:20.en: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment

37:21.ar: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
37:21.en: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny

37:22.ar: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
37:22.en: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

37:23.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
37:23.en: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell

37:24.en: And stop them, for they must be questioned

37:25.en: What aileth you that ye help not one another

37:26.en: Nay, but this day they make full submission

37:27.en: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37:28.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
37:28.en: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth)

37:29.en: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers

37:30.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
37:30.en: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk

37:31.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
37:31.en: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)

37:32.en: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray

37:33.en: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom

37:34.en: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty

37:35.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
37:35.en: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

37:36.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
37:36.en: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet

37:37.en: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him)

37:38.en: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom

37:39.ar: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
37:39.en: Ye are requited naught save what ye did

37:41.en: For them there is a known provision

37:42.en: Fruits. And they will be honoured

37:45.en: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them

37:47.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
37:47.en: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby

37:48.en: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes

37:49.en: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich)

37:50.en: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37:51.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
37:51.en: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

37:52.en: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)

37:53.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
37:53.en: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book

37:55.en: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell

37:56.en: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin

37:57.ar: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
37:57.en: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)

37:58.en: Are we then not to die

37:59.ar: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
37:59.en: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished

37:60.en: Lo! this is the supreme triumph

37:61.en: For the like of this, then, let the workers work

38:2.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲ‏
38:2.en: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism

38:3.ar: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏
38:3.en: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape

38:4.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
38:4.en: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan

38:5.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهࣰ ا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابࣱ‏
38:5.en: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing

38:6.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءࣱ يُرَادُ
38:6.en: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed

38:7.ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
38:7.en: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention

38:8.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
38:8.en: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom

38:9.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
38:9.en: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower

38:10.ar: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
38:10.en: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes

38:11.ar: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
38:11.en: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there

38:12.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
38:12.en: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted

38:13.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
38:13.en: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions

38:14.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
38:14.en: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified

38:15.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲ‏
38:15.en: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto

38:16.ar: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
38:16.en: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning

38:17.ar: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:17.en: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38:18.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
38:18.en: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise

38:19.en: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him

38:20.ar: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
38:20.en: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech

38:21.ar: ۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
38:21.en: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber

38:22.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
38:22.en: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way

38:23.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعࣱ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةࣰ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
38:23.en: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech

38:24.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعࣰ اۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
38:24.en: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented

38:25.ar: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:25.en: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end

38:26.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
38:26.en: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning

38:27.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
38:27.en: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire

38:28.ar: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
38:28.en: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked

38:29.ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
38:29.en: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect

38:30.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:30.en: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38:31.ar: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
38:31.en: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

38:32.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
38:32.en: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain

38:33.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
38:33.en: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks

38:34.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
38:34.en: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent

38:35.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكࣰ ا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
38:35.en: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower

38:36.ar: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
38:36.en: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended

38:37.en: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient)

38:38.en: And others linked together in chains

38:39.ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
38:39.en: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning

38:40.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:40.en: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end

38:41.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبࣲ وَعَذَابٍ
38:41.en: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment

38:42.ar: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ‏
38:42.en: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink

38:43.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
38:43.en: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding

38:44.ar: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثࣰ ا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرࣰ اۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
38:44.en: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord)

38:45.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
38:45.en: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision

38:46.en: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter)

38:47.en: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent

38:48.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
38:48.en: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen

38:49.ar: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:49.en: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end

38:50.en: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them

38:51.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲ‏
38:51.en: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein

38:52.en: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions

38:53.en: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning

38:54.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
38:54.en: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away

38:55.en: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end

38:56.en: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place

38:57.en: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it

38:58.en: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)

38:59.ar: هَٰذَا فَوۡجࣱ مُّقۡتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
38:59.en: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire

38:60.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
38:60.en: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight

38:61.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا ضِعۡفࣰ ا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
38:61.en: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire

36:62.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلࣰّ ا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
36:62.en: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense

36:63.en: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him)

36:64.en: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved

36:68.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
36:68.en: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense

36:69.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ وَقُرۡءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:69.en: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain

36:70.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
36:70.en: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers

36:71.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
36:71.en: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners

36:72.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:72.en: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food

36:73.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:73.en: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks

36:74.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
36:74.en: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped

36:75.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
36:75.en: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms

36:76.ar: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
36:76.en: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim

36:77.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:77.en: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent

36:78.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلࣰ ا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱ‏
36:78.en: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away

36:79.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
36:79.en: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation

36:80.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
36:80.en: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it

36:81.ar: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
36:81.en: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator

36:82.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
36:82.en: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is

36:83.ar: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:83.en: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back

37:75.en: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

37:76.en: And We saved him and his household from the great distress

37:77.en: And made his seed the survivors

37:78.en: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:79.en: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples

37:80.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:81.en: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves

37:82.en: Then We did drown the others

37:83.en: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

37:84.en: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart

37:85.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
37:85.en: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship

37:86.en: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire

37:87.en: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds

37:88.en: And he glanced a glance at the stars

37:89.en: Then said: Lo! I feel sick

37:90.en: And they turned their backs and went away from him

37:91.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
37:91.en: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat

37:92.en: What aileth you that ye speak not

37:93.en: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand

37:94.en: And (his people) came toward him, hastening

37:95.en: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

37:96.en: When Allah hath created you and what ye make

37:97.ar: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
37:97.en: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire

37:98.ar: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
37:98.en: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost

37:99.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
37:99.en: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me

37:100.en: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous

37:101.en: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son

37:102.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
37:102.en: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast

37:103.en: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face

37:104.en: We called unto him: O Abraham

37:105.ar: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
37:105.en: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:106.en: Lo! that verily was a clear test

37:107.en: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim

37:108.en: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:110.en: Thus do We reward the good

37:111.en: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves

37:112.ar: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
37:112.en: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous

37:113.ar: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
37:113.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves

37:114.en: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron

37:115.en: And saved them and their people from the great distress

37:116.en: And helped them so that they became the victors

37:117.en: And We gave them the clear Scripture

37:118.en: And showed them the right path

37:119.en: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation)

37:120.en: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron

37:121.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:122.en: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves

37:123.en: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)

37:124.en: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)

37:125.ar: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
37:125.en: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators

37:126.en: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

37:127.en: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

37:129.en: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:131.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:132.en: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves

37:133.en: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)

37:134.en: When We saved him and his household, every one

37:135.en: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind

37:137.en: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

37:138.en: And at night-time; have ye then no sense

37:139.en: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

37:140.en: When he fled unto the laden ship

37:141.en: And then drew lots and was of those rejected

37:142.en: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy

37:143.en: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

37:144.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
37:144.en: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised

37:145.en: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick

37:146.en: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him

37:147.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
37:147.en: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

37:148.en: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while

37:167.en: And indeed they used to say

37:168.ar: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
37:168.en: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

37:169.en: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah

37:170.en: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know

37:171.en: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

37:172.en: That they verily would be helped

37:173.en: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors

37:174.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile

37:175.en: And watch, for they will (soon) see

37:176.en: Would they hasten on Our doom

37:177.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
37:177.en: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned

37:179.en: And watch, for they will (soon) see

37:180.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
37:180.en: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

37:181.en: And peace be unto those sent (to warn)

37:182.en: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds

38:71.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن طِينࣲ‏
38:71.en: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire

38:72.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
38:72.en: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate

38:73.en: The angels fell down prostrate, every one

38:74.ar: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
38:74.en: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers

38:75.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
38:75.en: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted

38:76.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارࣲ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲ‏
38:76.en: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay

38:77.en: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

38:78.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
38:78.en: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment

38:79.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
38:79.en: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

38:80.en: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

38:81.en: Until the day of the time appointed

38:82.en: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one

38:83.en: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them

38:84.en: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak

38:85.ar: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
38:85.en: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together

38:86.ar: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرࣲ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
38:86.en: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating

38:87.en: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

38:88.en: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof

XfRMTzmyYpk.speaker: adnan
XfRMTzmyYpk.speaker_note: his A Juz A Day Ramadan series; same format and voice as other episodes
XfRMTzmyYpk.title: A Juz A Day: Juz 23, Being Optimistic and Learning from Mistakes
XfRMTzmyYpk.one_line: Ya-Sin teaches optimism in dawah, as-Saffat that Allah's warnings come true, and Sad how prophets erred and were corrected.
XfRMTzmyYpk.summary: He covers Ya-Sin, as-Saffat and Sad. In Ya-Sin the Prophet is told that many will not listen, yet there is always reason for optimism: results belong to Allah, and the man who came running from the far end of the city, believed, was killed and still wished his people well shows that even one believer is enough. He walks through the signs of the revived earth, pairs in creation and the ordered orbits of sun and moon, arguing that admiring creation must lead to thanking Allah and certainty of resurrection, with the trumpet blasts and the scenes of paradise. In as-Saffat, whose short bursting verses aim to wake people, the theme is that Allah's threats are fulfilled; he highlights the companion in paradise who nearly was ruined by a doubting friend, a lesson about the influence of the people around us, and the prophets Allah rewarded, especially Ibrahim consulting his son and Yunus showing the door of tawbah is open. In Sad he focuses on prophets' errors of judgment: Dawud ruling before hearing both sides, Sulayman distracted by his horses, Ayyub's rash oath. Each repented and remained honoured, unlike Iblis, whose refusal was defiance, not a mistake. He asks the audience to learn from mistakes and give others room to grow.

outline.heading: Juz 23 and the last seventh of the Quran
outline.gist: The juz spans Ya-Sin, as-Saffat, Sad and the start of az-Zumar, entering the final seventh the companions used for weekly completion.

outline.heading: Ya-Sin opens: warning a heedless people
outline.gist: Many will not believe as if shackled and veiled; the Prophet's task is only to warn.

outline.heading: Reason for optimism: numbers do not matter
outline.gist: Keep calling everyone; those who follow the reminder will respond, and a small number is still success.

outline.heading: The town and its three messengers
outline.gist: Results are in Allah's hands; the dawah was reinforced with a third messenger despite rejection.

outline.heading: The man from the far end of the city
outline.gist: He argues for worshipping the One who created him; Allah is the Lord of all, not one team's god.

outline.heading: Killed, entering paradise, wishing his people knew
outline.gist: A true caller holds no grudge even against his killers; one believer is reason enough to continue.

outline.heading: Destroyed generations and the dead earth revived
outline.gist: Life and death as reasons to take heed; Allah brings barren land to life with grain and gardens.

outline.heading: Enjoy the blessings and thank Allah
outline.gist: We do not make food grow; reminders of provision aim at enjoyment with gratitude, not guilt.

outline.heading: Everything created in pairs
outline.gist: Uniform design and diverse forms point to one planner.

outline.heading: Night, sun and moon each in its orbit
outline.gist: Order and harmony from the cosmos to the atom cannot be coincidence.

outline.heading: Ships, mercy at sea, and why creation is paired with resurrection
outline.gist: Admiring creation must lead to recognizing the Creator, thanking Him and being certain of resurrection.

outline.heading: The two trumpet blasts
outline.gist: The first blast ends all life, the second raises everyone at once.

outline.heading: The people of paradise and the question to the children of Adam
outline.gist: Peace as a greeting from the Lord, and the reminder that Satan is a sworn enemy.

outline.heading: Long life reversed: life is temporary
outline.gist: Decline in old age shows life is temporary and resurrection true.

outline.heading: Not poetry: a warning to the truly alive
outline.gist: A person is truly alive when their heart accepts reminders and changes.

outline.heading: Cattle subjected to us; idols that cannot help
outline.gist: Huge animals made easy for human benefit, while pagans guard idols that do nothing for them.

outline.heading: Do not let their words grieve you
outline.gist: The Prophet was saddened by people who knew him turning into enemies; it was not his fault.

outline.heading: Created from a drop, so He can revive bones
outline.gist: The Creator of the cosmos easily resurrects; He says be and it is.

outline.heading: As-Saffat's style: short verses in bursts
outline.gist: The rhythm is meant to wake the listener.

outline.heading: Allah's threats will be fulfilled; oaths by the angels
outline.gist: The Lord of the heavens and of every point of sunrise.

outline.heading: Mockery of resurrection and the single blast
outline.gist: When they rise it is too late to believe.

outline.heading: Detain them for questioning
outline.gist: The wrongdoers and what they worshipped are gathered, unable to help one another.

outline.heading: A mad poet? Character assassination when the message cannot be refuted
outline.gist: The Prophet had no history of poetry; slander replaces argument.

outline.heading: The pure drink of paradise
outline.gist: Unlike alcohol it neither harms nor intoxicates.

outline.heading: The companion who doubted resurrection
outline.gist: A person in paradise sees his former friend in hell and says he nearly ruined him.

outline.heading: The influence of the people around us
outline.gist: Friends and those we look up to shape how we see the world; be cautious of who influences you.

outline.heading: Nuh and the repeated refrains
outline.gist: Four phrases recur for each prophet: delivered, honourable mention, peace upon him, this is how we reward the good.

outline.heading: Ibrahim breaks the idols and is thrown in the fire
outline.gist: His logic was answered with violence, and Allah saved him.

outline.heading: Ibrahim always on the move
outline.gist: A comfort for those whose lives keep moving them from place to place.

outline.heading: Ibrahim consults his son about the dream
outline.gist: Asking his son's view of a divine command builds self-esteem and respect in the young.

outline.heading: The ransom and Ibrahim's double honour
outline.gist: The test is passed and the refrain of reward is said twice for Ibrahim alone.

outline.heading: Musa and Harun
outline.gist: Saved, guided and honoured.

outline.heading: Ilyas and the idol Ba'l
outline.gist: Those who answered his call were spared.

outline.heading: Lut and the ruins on the trade route
outline.gist: Makkans passed Sodom's ruins on their journeys yet did not reflect.

outline.heading: Yunus: the runaway on the overloaded ship
outline.gist: He left before being permitted; his constant glorification saved him from the whale.

outline.heading: Yunus's people believed: the door of tawbah is open
outline.gist: Over a hundred thousand believed and the punishment was lifted.

outline.heading: Messengers will be helped; turn away for a while
outline.gist: Do not engage fruitlessly with mockery, but keep preaching.

outline.heading: Closing praise of as-Saffat
outline.gist: Glory to Allah and peace upon the messengers.

outline.heading: Sad: prophets' mistakes and how Allah corrects them
outline.gist: The surah's distinctive thread: errors of judgment and the lessons drawn.

outline.heading: Has he made the gods one? A scheme for power
outline.gist: The chiefs accuse the Prophet of seeking power and ask why he was chosen.

outline.heading: Do they own the treasuries of Allah's mercy?
outline.gist: They have no right to decide whom Allah chooses.

outline.heading: Dawud, the man of strength
outline.gist: Mountains and birds glorified with him; he was given kingship and wisdom.

outline.heading: The two litigants: Dawud rules before hearing both sides
outline.gist: Swayed by the numbers 99 and one, he judged too fast, then repented and was forgiven.

outline.heading: Judge with truth, not desire
outline.gist: Authority brings responsibility; do not be overwhelmed by the optics of an argument.

outline.heading: Creation is not without purpose; contemplate the book
outline.gist: The Quran's purpose is reflection that leads to realization and implementation, not ritual alone.

outline.heading: Sulayman distracted by his horses
outline.gist: He missed the prayer, repented and made amends, and remained close to Allah.

outline.heading: Ayyub's rash oath and the bundle of grass
outline.gist: A sick man's regretted oath fulfilled without harming his wife, and his family restored twofold.

outline.heading: Everybody makes mistakes; not all mistakes are equal
outline.gist: Ayyub was overwhelmingly patient; other prophets are named among the chosen.

outline.heading: Iblis: defiance, not a mistake
outline.gist: He questioned Allah's judgment and blamed Allah, unlike prophets who erred and repented.

outline.heading: Learning from mistakes and reconciling
outline.gist: Prophets' errors make them role models of repentance; we should grow from our mistakes and allow others to.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Hope, fear and the balance between them
themes.note: Optimism in dawah: results belong to Allah and even one believer is enough.

themes.label: Dawah, outreach and representing Islam
themes.note: Keep calling regardless of numbers; the believing man shows dawah without grudges.

themes.label: Gratitude (shukr) and appreciation
themes.note: Blessings are meant to be enjoyed and then thanked.

themes.label: Eman: faith, certainty, doubt
themes.note: Order in creation leads to the Creator and to certainty of resurrection.

themes.label: The Hereafter: resurrection, judgment, paradise, hellfire
themes.note: The trumpet blasts, paradise and the questioning of humanity.

themes.label: Brotherhood, companionship and friendship
themes.note: A doubting friend nearly ruined a man of paradise; guard who influences you.

themes.label: Stories of earlier prophets
themes.note: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Harun, Ilyas, Lut and Yunus and how Allah rewards the good.

themes.label: Tawbah: repentance and returning to Allah
themes.note: Prophets' errors of judgment were corrected and forgiven; Iblis's defiance was different.

themes.label: Justice and refusing oppression
themes.note: Hear both sides and judge by truth, not desire or optics.

themes.label: Parenting and raising children
themes.note: Ibrahim asks his son's opinion to build his self-esteem.

maxims: The results are in the hands of Allah
It's not a team sport: your god versus my god
Enjoy the pleasures and thank Allah
If you cannot refute the message, you attack the messenger
Not all mistakes are the same

stories.who: The man from the far end of the city
stories.point: Even one believer justifies optimism; true callers carry no grudge.

stories.who: The companion in paradise and his doubting friend
stories.point: The people we keep close shape our destiny.
Consult the young to build their respect and self-esteem.
The door of tawbah remains open.
Never judge before hearing both sides.
Mistakes said in suffering can be resolved without harm.
Defiance of Allah is not the same as an error of judgment.

takeaways: Keep doing dawah without measuring success by numbers.
Enjoy Allah's blessings and consciously thank Him for them.
Choose carefully the friends and voices that influence how you see the world.
Hear both sides before judging any dispute.
Own your mistakes, repent and grow, and let others do the same.

39:1.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
39:1.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

39:2.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ فَٱعۡبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصࣰ ا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
39:2.en: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39:3.ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡخَالِصُۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مَا نَعۡبُدُهُمۡ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ فِي مَا هُمۡ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَنۡ هُوَ كَٰذِبࣱ كَفَّارࣱ‏
39:3.en: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate

39:4.ar: لَّوۡ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدࣰ ا لَّٱصۡطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
39:4.en: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute

39:5.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلࣱّ يَجۡرِي لِأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
39:5.en: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver

39:6.ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفۡسࣲ وَٰحِدَةࣲ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۡهَا زَوۡجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزۡوَٰجࣲۚ يَخۡلُقُكُمۡ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ خَلۡقࣰ ا مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ خَلۡقࣲ فِي ظُلُمَٰتࣲ ثَلَٰثࣲۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡمُلۡكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
39:6.en: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away

39:7.ar: إِن تَكۡفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمۡۖ وَلَا يَرۡضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلۡكُفۡرَۖ وَإِن تَشۡكُرُواْ يَرۡضَهُ لَكُمۡۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةࣱ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
39:7.en: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men)

39:8.ar: ۞وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مِن قَبۡلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادࣰ ا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۚ قُلۡ تَمَتَّعۡ بِكُفۡرِكَ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكَ مِنۡ أَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
39:8.en: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire

39:9.ar: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدࣰ ا وَقَآئِمࣰ ا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
39:9.en: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed

39:10.ar: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةࣱۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
39:10.en: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint

39:11.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصࣰ ا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
39:11.en: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39:12.en: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him)

39:13.ar: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ إِنۡ عَصَيۡتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمࣲ‏
39:13.en: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day

39:14.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعۡبُدُ مُخۡلِصࣰ ا لَّهُۥ دِينِي
39:14.en: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only)

39:15.ar: فَٱعۡبُدُواْ مَا شِئۡتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۗ قُلۡ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
39:15.en: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss

39:16.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوۡقِهِمۡ ظُلَلࣱ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحۡتِهِمۡ ظُلَلࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
39:16.en: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me

39:17.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَنَبُواْ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعۡبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلۡبُشۡرَىٰۚ فَبَشِّرۡ عِبَادِ
39:17.en: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen

39:18.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحۡسَنَهُۥٓۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
39:18.en: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding

39:19.ar: أَفَمَنۡ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ
39:19.en: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire

39:20.ar: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ لَهُمۡ غُرَفࣱ مِّن فَوۡقِهَا غُرَفࣱ مَّبۡنِيَّةࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ لَا يُخۡلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
39:20.en: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise

39:21.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعࣰ ا مُّخۡتَلِفًا أَلۡوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصۡفَرࣰّ ا ثُمَّ يَجۡعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
39:21.en: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding

39:22.ar: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدۡرَهُۥ لِلۡإِسۡلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلۡقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
39:22.en: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error

39:23.ar: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبࣰ ا مُّتَشَٰبِهࣰ ا مَّثَانِيَ تَقۡشَعِرُّ مِنۡهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمۡ وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٍ
39:23.en: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39:24.ar: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجۡهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡسِبُونَ
39:24.en: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn

39:25.ar: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
39:25.en: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not

39:26.ar: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
39:26.en: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know

39:27.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلࣲ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
39:27.en: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect

39:28.ar: قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيۡرَ ذِي عِوَجࣲ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ
39:28.en: A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil)

39:29.ar: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلࣰ ا رَّجُلࣰ ا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلࣰ ا سَلَمࣰ ا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
39:29.en: Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not

39:30.en: Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die

39:31.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمۡ تَخۡتَصِمُونَ
39:31.en: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute

39:32.ar: ۞فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُۥٓۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوࣰ ى لِّلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
39:32.en: And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell

39:33.ar: وَٱلَّذِي جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَ
39:33.en: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful

39:34.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
39:34.en: They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good

39:35.ar: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَهُمۡ أَجۡرَهُم بِأَحۡسَنِ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
39:35.en: That Allah will remit from them the worst of what they did, and will pay them for reward the best they used to do

39:36.ar: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادࣲ‏
39:36.en: Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39:37.ar: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزࣲ ذِي ٱنتِقَامࣲ‏
39:37.en: And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)

39:38.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُۚ قُلۡ أَفَرَءَيۡتُم مَّا تَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَادَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلۡ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوۡ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحۡمَةٍ هَلۡ هُنَّ مُمۡسِكَٰتُ رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ قُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُۖ عَلَيۡهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ ٱلۡمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
39:38.en: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust

39:39.ar: قُلۡ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنِّي عَٰمِلࣱۖ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
39:39.en: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know

39:40.ar: مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابࣱ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابࣱ مُّقِيمٌ
39:40.en: Who it is unto whom cometh a doom that will abase him, and on whom there falleth everlasting doom

39:41.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيۡهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلٍ
39:41.en: Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them

39:42.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
39:42.en: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought

39:43.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۚ قُلۡ أَوَلَوۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
39:43.en: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence

39:44.ar: قُل لِّلَّهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعࣰ اۖ لَّهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
39:44.en: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back

39:45.ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُ ٱشۡمَأَزَّتۡ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
39:45.en: And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad

39:46.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ عَٰلِمَ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
39:46.en: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ

39:47.ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا وَمِثۡلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفۡتَدَوۡاْ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلۡعَذَابِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمۡ يَكُونُواْ يَحۡتَسِبُونَ
39:47.en: And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned

39:48.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
39:48.en: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them

39:49.ar: فَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلۡنَٰهُ نِعۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمِۭۚ بَلۡ هِيَ فِتۡنَةࣱ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
39:49.en: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not

39:50.ar: قَدۡ قَالَهَا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَمَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
39:50.en: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not

39:51.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
39:51.en: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape

39:52.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
39:52.en: Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe

39:53.ar: ۞قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
39:53.en: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

39:54.ar: وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ وَأَسۡلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
39:54.en: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped

39:55.ar: وَٱتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحۡسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَكُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ بَغۡتَةࣰ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
39:55.en: And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not

39:56.ar: أَن تَقُولَ نَفۡسࣱ يَٰحَسۡرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنۢبِ ٱللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ ٱلسَّٰخِرِينَ
39:56.en: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers

39:57.ar: أَوۡ تَقُولَ لَوۡ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هَدَىٰنِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
39:57.en: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful

39:58.ar: أَوۡ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى ٱلۡعَذَابَ لَوۡ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةࣰ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
39:58.en: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous

39:59.ar: بَلَىٰ قَدۡ جَآءَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتِي فَكَذَّبۡتَ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
39:59.en: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers

39:60.ar: وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسۡوَدَّةٌۚ أَلَيۡسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثۡوࣰ ى لِّلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
39:60.en: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell

39:61.ar: وَيُنَجِّي ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمۡ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ ٱلسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
39:61.en: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve

40:2.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
40:2.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower

40:3.ar: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوۡبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلۡعِقَابِ ذِي ٱلطَّوۡلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
40:3.en: The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in punishment, the Bountiful. There is no Allah save Him. Unto Him is the journeying

40:4.ar: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَلَا يَغۡرُرۡكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
40:4.en: None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad)

40:5.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡۖ وَهَمَّتۡ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۭ بِرَسُولِهِمۡ لِيَأۡخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِٱلۡبَٰطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُواْ بِهِ ٱلۡحَقَّ فَأَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
40:5.en: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment

40:6.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
40:6.en: Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire

40:7.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحۡمِلُونَ ٱلۡعَرۡشَ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعۡتَ كُلَّ شَيۡءࣲ رَّحۡمَةࣰ وَعِلۡمࣰ ا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
40:7.en: Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell

40:8.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
40:8.en: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise

40:9.ar: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
40:9.en: And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph

40:10.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوۡنَ لَمَقۡتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكۡبَرُ مِن مَّقۡتِكُمۡ أَنفُسَكُمۡ إِذۡ تُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكۡفُرُونَ
40:10.en: Lo! (on that day) those who disbelieve are informed by proclamation: Verily Allah's abhorrence is more terrible than your abhorrence one of another, when ye were called unto the faith but did refuse

40:11.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ وَأَحۡيَيۡتَنَا ٱثۡنَتَيۡنِ فَٱعۡتَرَفۡنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلۡ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجࣲ مِّن سَبِيلࣲ‏
40:11.en: They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out

40:12.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ
40:12.en: (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic

40:13.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزۡقࣰ اۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
40:13.en: He it is Who showeth you His portents, and sendeth down for you provision from the sky. None payeth heed save him who turneth (unto Him) repentant

40:14.ar: فَٱدۡعُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
40:14.en: Therefor (O believers) pray unto Allah, making religion pure for Him (only), however much the disbelievers be averse

40:15.ar: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ يُلۡقِي ٱلرُّوحَ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
40:15.en: The Exalter of Ranks, the Lord of the Throne. He causeth the Spirit of His command upon whom He will of His slaves, that He may warn of the Day of Meeting

40:16.ar: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءࣱۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
40:16.en: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty

40:17.ar: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡۚ لَا ظُلۡمَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
40:17.en: This day is each soul requited that which it hath earned; no wrong (is done) this day. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning

40:18.ar: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمࣲ وَلَا شَفِيعࣲ يُطَاعُ
40:18.en: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard

40:19.ar: يَعۡلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنِ وَمَا تُخۡفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
40:19.en: He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide

40:20.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَقۡضِي بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقۡضُونَ بِشَيۡءٍۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
40:20.en: Allah judgeth with truth, while those to whom they cry instead of Him judge not at all. Lo! Allah, He is the Hearer, the Seer

40:21.ar: ۞أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةࣰ وَءَاثَارࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقࣲ‏
40:21.en: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who disbelieved before them? They were mightier than these in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah

40:22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَانَت تَّأۡتِيهِمۡ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيࣱّ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
40:22.en: That was because their messengers kept bringing them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) but they disbelieved; so Allah seized them. Lo! He is Strong, severe in punishment

40:23.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
40:23.en: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

40:24.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابࣱ‏
40:24.en: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer

40:25.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ مِنۡ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ ٱقۡتُلُوٓاْ أَبۡنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسۡتَحۡيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمۡۚ وَمَا كَيۡدُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ‏
40:25.en: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error

40:26.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ ذَرُونِيٓ أَقۡتُلۡ مُوسَىٰ وَلۡيَدۡعُ رَبَّهُۥٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمۡ أَوۡ أَن يُظۡهِرَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡفَسَادَ
40:26.en: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land
