Finally 51:22-23 swears that provision is as certain as people's talking, so worry and haram earnings are pointless.

outline.heading: Opening
Similes as a Quranic theme, distinct from stories
outline.gist: The Quran constantly says 'this is like that'; people need an example before a concept feels rational, and they test the example against the concept.

outline.heading: No example, no teaching
outline.gist: A bad or partial example makes listeners question the point; he will not teach a concept until he finds an example that fully fits, or people will misapply it.

outline.heading: The Quran as master of examples
outline.gist: Had its examples been weak, the Quran would have lost its ethical and legal credibility over time; their accuracy is what kept it.

outline.heading: Examples that do not expire
outline.gist: Irrelevant examples lose an audience and a 1985 lecture's examples already feel foreign, yet the Quran's stay applicable in every era; scholars have written whole books on its similes.

outline.heading: 48:29 and the three surahs about the Prophet
outline.gist: Muhammad, al-Fath and al-Hujurat form a cluster teaching who the Prophet is and how to follow him; al-Fath closes with a verse full of similes.

outline.heading: Firm with enemies, merciful with each other
outline.gist: Strictness is for those who attack your rights, never for fellow Muslims; the companions are constantly bowing, prostrating and seeking Allah's bounty and pleasure.

outline.heading: Their description in the Torah: five traits
outline.gist: The Torah's description is plain and practical: strength against enemies, compassion, ongoing prayer, connection with Allah and seeking only His favour; he notes how translations obscured these prophecies.

outline.heading: The mark of prostration is serenity in the face
outline.gist: Not the callus on the forehead but inner calm that shows on the face; people read faces instinctively, and long prostration leaves its blessing there.

outline.heading: Their description in the Gospel: the growing crop
outline.gist: A shoot breaks from the seed, is propped up, thickens and stands on its stalk, delighting the sowers and vexing rivals; he explains kuffar here as farmers who cover seed with soil.

outline.heading: Dawah as planting seeds one by one
outline.gist: His favourite of the two similes: Muslims plant seeds of iman in people and in the next generation, as the Prophet taught and protected each companion individually.

outline.heading: Gentle, patient care that never ends
outline.gist: The weak shoot needs protecting, then encouragement even once strong; nobody yells at a seed or uproots it for growing slowly, and a tree takes a decade of daily attention.

outline.heading: His uncle talking to the apricot trees
outline.gist: In Syria he once found his elderly uncle greeting and stroking his trees; that tenderness is the picture of how Muslims are meant to nurture.

outline.heading: What Muslim communities in the West are for
outline.gist: Any vision for Muslim communities that does not centre education and mentorship of the next generation, building their identity, voice and courage, misses the point of this simile.

outline.heading: The masjid as the training ground for youth
outline.gist: Let nervous young people lead prayer and make mistakes; every child in the masjid is ours, and if we do not nurture them someone else will make them their crop.

outline.heading: 49:12: avoid most assumptions
outline.gist: Al-Hujurat is the surah of etiquette; the mind fills gaps with suspicion, and the rule is to avoid most of something when some of it is harmful.

outline.heading: No spying, no backbiting, and the corpse simile
outline.gist: Do not chase people's secrets or speak behind their backs; would you eat your dead brother's flesh? You would hate it, so hate backbiting.

outline.heading: Interlude
Three ways the simile fits
outline.gist: The absent cannot defend themselves, you take their dignity and reputation, and your gain is a rotten boost to your ego from putting them down.

outline.heading: Legitimate talk versus the taste of backbiting
outline.gist: Parents, caregivers and mentors may discuss someone in their care; backbiting is the talk with no protective purpose that you crave and savour.

outline.heading: 51:22-23: provision is as certain as your talking
outline.gist: Allah swears that what is decreed for you is as real as the fact that people never stop talking, so there is no point in sleepless worry, broken relationships or haram earnings.

themes.label: Similes and examples in the Quran
themes.note: He presents the Quran's similes as a teaching method whose accuracy and timelessness preserved its credibility, then decodes three of them.

themes.label: Public speaking and khutbah delivery
themes.note: A teacher must find an example that fully fits and is relevant to the audience, or the point is doubted or misapplied.

themes.label: The companions and the early generations
themes.note: The companions' traits in the Torah and Gospel: firmness with enemies, mercy among themselves, constant prayer and serenity in the face.

themes.label: Dawah, outreach and representing Islam
themes.note: Dawah is planting and tending seeds of iman with patience, the way the Prophet nurtured each companion.

themes.label: Youth, their challenges and their role
themes.note: Education and mentorship of the next generation is the first purpose of Western Muslim communities; youth must be allowed to practise and err in the masjid.

themes.label: Muslim identity and life in the West / Canada
themes.note: He weighs what Muslim societies in the West exist to do and puts strong identity and voice for the young at the centre.

themes.label: Guarding the tongue; speech and gossip
themes.note: Assumptions, spying and backbiting, with the corpse simile unpacked into three exact correspondences and the exceptions for caregivers.

themes.label: Tawakkul: reliance on Allah
themes.note: Provision is decreed and sworn to, so anxiety and haram means gain nothing.

hadith.gist: A person who keeps praying (at night) will have its blessing show in his face.

maxims: If you can't give an example, don't teach it
A bad example makes you question the point
We are planting seeds of iman
Every kid in this masjid is my child
They'll become their crop, not yours

stories.point: He found his uncle talking to and stroking his apricot trees; nurturing people and the next generation needs that same tender, daily attention.

contemporary: The priorities of Muslim communities in the West: education and mentorship first, alongside dawah, financial centralization and advocacy
takeaways: Before teaching a point, find an example that fully fits it and fits the audience's life.
Treat dawah and youth work as patient seed planting: protect, support and keep encouraging people even once they are strong.
Let young people lead prayer and make mistakes in the masjid, and treat every child there as your own.
Avoid most assumptions, do not dig into people's private lives, and stop any talk about someone that serves no protective purpose.
Trust that provision is decreed and refuse worry or haram earnings as ways to secure it.

41:26.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ
41:26.en: Those who disbelieve say: Heed not this Qur'an, and drown the hearing of it; haply ye may conquer

41:27.ar: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابࣰ ا شَدِيدࣰ ا وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
41:27.en: But verily We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste an awful doom, and verily We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do

41:28.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ أَعۡدَآءِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلنَّارُۖ لَهُمۡ فِيهَا دَارُ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
41:28.en: That is the reward of Allah's enemies: the Fire. Therein is their immortal home, payment forasmuch as they denied Our revelations

41:29.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَرِنَا ٱلَّذَيۡنِ أَضَلَّانَا مِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ وَٱلۡإِنسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ أَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُونَا مِنَ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
41:29.en: And those who disbelieve will say: Our Lord! Show us those who beguiled us of the jinn and humankind. We will place them underneath our feet that they may be among the nethermost

41:30.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَقَٰمُواْ تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَلَّا تَخَافُواْ وَلَا تَحۡزَنُواْ وَأَبۡشِرُواْ بِٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
41:30.en: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and afterward are upright, the angels descend upon them, saying: Fear not nor grieve, but hear good tidings of the paradise which ye are promised

41:31.ar: نَحۡنُ أَوۡلِيَآؤُكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَفِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۖ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيٓ أَنفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
41:31.en: We are your protecting friends in the life of the world and in the Hereafter. There ye will have (all) that your souls desire, and there ye will have (all) for which ye pray

41:32.en: A gift of welcome from One Forgiving, Merciful

41:33.ar: وَمَنۡ أَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
41:33.en: And who is better in speech than him who prayeth unto his Lord and doeth right, and saith: Lo! I am of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him)

41:34.ar: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا ٱلسَّيِّئَةُۚ ٱدۡفَعۡ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِي بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهُۥ عَدَٰوَةࣱ كَأَنَّهُۥ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيمࣱ‏
41:34.en: The good deed and the evil deed are not alike. Repel the evil deed with one which is better, then lo! he, between whom and thee there was enmity (will become) as though he was a bosom friend

41:35.ar: وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُواْ وَمَا يُلَقَّىٰهَآ إِلَّا ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمࣲ‏
41:35.en: But none is granted it save those who are steadfast, and none is granted it save the owner of great happiness

41:36.ar: وَإِمَّا يَنزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ نَزۡغࣱ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
41:36.en: And if a whisper from the devil reach thee (O Muhammad) then seek refuge in Allah. Lo! He is the Hearer, the Knower

41:37.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمۡسُ وَٱلۡقَمَرُۚ لَا تَسۡجُدُواْ لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ إِن كُنتُمۡ إِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُونَ
41:37.en: And of His portents are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or the moon; but prostrate to Allah Who created them, if it is in truth Him Whom ye worship

41:38.ar: فَإِنِ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فَٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُونَ لَهُۥ بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔمُونَ۩
41:38.en: But if they are too proud - still those who are with thy Lord glorify Him night and day, and tire not

41:39.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنَّكَ تَرَى ٱلۡأَرۡضَ خَٰشِعَةࣰ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَآءَ ٱهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرٌ
41:39.en: And of His portents (is this): that thou seest the earth lowly, but when We send down water thereon it thrilleth and groweth. Lo! He Who quickeneth it is verily the Quickener of the Dead. Lo! He is Able to do all things

41:40.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلۡحِدُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا لَا يَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَيۡنَآۗ أَفَمَن يُلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلنَّارِ خَيۡرٌ أَم مَّن يَأۡتِيٓ ءَامِنࣰ ا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۚ ٱعۡمَلُواْ مَا شِئۡتُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
41:40.en: Lo! those who distort Our revelations are not hid from Us. Is he who is hurled into the Fire better, or he who cometh secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what ye will. Lo! He is Seer of what ye do

41:41.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِٱلذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۖ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَكِتَٰبٌ عَزِيزࣱ‏
41:41.en: Lo! those who disbelieve in the Reminder when it cometh unto them (are guilty), for lo! it is an unassailable Scripture

41:42.ar: لَّا يَأۡتِيهِ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦۖ تَنزِيلࣱ مِّنۡ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدࣲ‏
41:42.en: Falsehood cannot come at it from before it or from behind it. (It is) a revelation from the Wise, the Owner of Praise

41:43.ar: مَّا يُقَالُ لَكَ إِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِن قَبۡلِكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ‏
41:43.en: Naught is said unto thee (Muhammad) save what was said unto the messengers before thee. Lo! thy Lord is owner of forgiveness, and owner (also) of dire punishment

41:44.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا أَعۡجَمِيࣰّ ا لَّقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥٓۖ ءَا۬عۡجَمِيࣱّ وَعَرَبِيࣱّۗ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هُدࣰ ى وَشِفَآءࣱۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرࣱ وَهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًىۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
41:44.en: And if We had appointed it a Lecture in a foreign tongue they would assuredly have said: If only its verses were expounded (so that we might understand)? What! A foreign tongue and an Arab? - Say unto them (O Muhammad): For those who believe it is a guidance and a healing; and as for those who disbelieve, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness for them. Such are called to from afar

41:45.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَٱخۡتُلِفَ فِيهِۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةࣱ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَفِي شَكࣲّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبࣲ‏
41:45.en: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, but there hath been dispute concerning it; and but for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord, it would ere now have been judged between them; but lo! they are in hopeless doubt concerning it

41:46.ar: مَّنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
41:46.en: Whoso doeth right it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong it is against it. And thy Lord is not at all a tyrant to His slaves

41:47.ar: ۞إِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِۚ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِن ثَمَرَٰتࣲ مِّنۡ أَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهِۦۚ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ أَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِي قَالُوٓاْ ءَاذَنَّٰكَ مَا مِنَّا مِن شَهِيدࣲ‏
41:47.en: Unto Him is referred (all) knowledge of the Hour. And no fruits burst forth from their sheaths, and no female carrieth or bringeth forth but with His knowledge. And on the day when He calleth unto them: Where are now My partners? they will say: We confess unto Thee, not one of us is a witness (for them)

41:48.ar: وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَدۡعُونَ مِن قَبۡلُۖ وَظَنُّواْ مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصࣲ‏
41:48.en: And those to whom they used to cry of old have failed them, and they perceive they have no place of refuge

41:49.ar: لَّا يَسۡـَٔمُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسࣱ قَنُوطࣱ‏
41:49.en: Man tireth not of praying for good, and if ill toucheth him, then he is disheartened, desperate

41:50.ar: وَلَئِنۡ أَذَقۡنَٰهُ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ هَٰذَا لِي وَمَآ أَظُنُّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةࣰ وَلَئِن رُّجِعۡتُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّيٓ إِنَّ لِي عِندَهُۥ لَلۡحُسۡنَىٰۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظࣲ‏
41:50.en: And verily, if We cause him to taste mercy after some hurt that hath touched him, he will say: This is my own; and I deem not that the Hour will ever rise, and if I am brought back to my Lord, I surely shall be better off with Him - But We verily shall tell those who disbelieve (all) that they did, and We verily shall make them taste hard punishment

41:51.ar: وَإِذَآ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ أَعۡرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَذُو دُعَآءٍ عَرِيضࣲ‏
41:51.en: When We show favour unto man, he withdraweth and turneth aside, but when ill toucheth him then he aboundeth in prayer

41:52.ar: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
41:52.en: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)

41:53.ar: سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا فِي ٱلۡأٓفَاقِ وَفِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
41:53.en: We shall show them Our portents on the horizons and within themselves until it will be manifest unto them that it is the Truth. Doth not thy Lord suffice, since He is Witness over all things

41:54.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُمۡ فِي مِرۡيَةࣲ مِّن لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡۗ أَلَآ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ مُّحِيطُۢ
41:54.en: How! Are they still in doubt about the meeting with their Lord? Lo! Is not He surrounding all things

42:3.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يُوحِيٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
42:3.en: Thus Allah the Mighty, the Knower inspireth thee (Muhammad) as (He inspired) those before thee

42:4.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
42:4.en: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

42:5.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِن فَوۡقِهِنَّۚ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُونَ لِمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
42:5.en: Almost might the heavens above be rent asunder while the angels hymn the praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on the earth. Lo! Allah, He is the Forgiver, the Merciful

42:6.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهُ حَفِيظٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِوَكِيلࣲ‏
42:6.en: And as for those who choose protecting friends beside Him, Allah is Warden over them, and thou art in no wise a guardian over them

42:7.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا لِّتُنذِرَ أُمَّ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهَا وَتُنذِرَ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡجَمۡعِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِۚ فَرِيقࣱ فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَفَرِيقࣱ فِي ٱلسَّعِيرِ
42:7.en: And thus We have inspired in thee a Lecture in Arabic, that thou mayst warn the mother-town and those around it, and mayst warn of a day of assembling whereof there is no doubt. A host will be in the Garden, and a host of them in the Flame

42:8.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَهُمۡ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ وَلَٰكِن يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَا لَهُم مِّن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
42:8.en: Had Allah willed, He could have made them one community, but Allah bringeth whom He will into His mercy. And the wrong-doers have no friend nor helper

42:9.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ فَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ وَهُوَ يُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
42:9.en: Or have they chosen protecting friends besides Him? But Allah, He (alone) is the Protecting Friend. He quickeneth the dead, and He is Able to do all things

42:10.ar: وَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفۡتُمۡ فِيهِ مِن شَيۡءࣲ فَحُكۡمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّي عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَإِلَيۡهِ أُنِيبُ
42:10.en: And in whatsoever ye differ, the verdict therein belongeth to Allah. Such is my Lord, in Whom I put my trust, and unto Whom I turn

42:11.ar: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءࣱۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
42:11.en: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He hath made for you pairs of yourselves, and of the cattle also pairs, whereby He multiplieth you. Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer

42:12.ar: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمࣱ‏
42:12.en: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlargeth providence for whom He will and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! He is Knower of all things

42:13.ar: ۞شَرَعَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا وَصَّىٰ بِهِۦ نُوحࣰ ا وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَا وَصَّيۡنَا بِهِۦٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰٓۖ أَنۡ أَقِيمُواْ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَا تَتَفَرَّقُواْ فِيهِۚ كَبُرَ عَلَى ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مَا تَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِۚ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡتَبِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيٓ إِلَيۡهِ مَن يُنِيبُ
42:13.en: He hath ordained for you that religion which He commended unto Noah, and that which We inspire in thee (Muhammad), and that which We commended unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying: Establish the religion, and be not divided therein. Dreadful for the idolaters is that unto which thou callest them. Allah chooseth for Himself whom He will, and guideth unto Himself him who turneth (toward Him)

42:14.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةࣱ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمࣰّ ى لَّقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِمۡ لَفِي شَكࣲّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيبࣲ‏
42:14.en: And they were not divided until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves; and had it not been for a Word that had already gone forth from thy Lord for an appointed term, it surely had been judged between them. And those who were made to inherit the Scripture after them are verily in hopeless doubt concerning it

42:15.ar: فَلِذَٰلِكَ فَٱدۡعُۖ وَٱسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَآ أُمِرۡتَۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۖ وَقُلۡ ءَامَنتُ بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن كِتَٰبࣲۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ لِأَعۡدِلَ بَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكُمۡۖ لَنَآ أَعۡمَٰلُنَا وَلَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡۖ لَا حُجَّةَ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمُۖ ٱللَّهُ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَاۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
42:15.en: Unto this, then, summon (O Muhammad). And be thou upright as thou art commanded, and follow not their lusts, but say: I believe in whatever scripture Allah hath sent down, and I am commanded to be just among you. Allah is our Lord and your Lord. Unto us our works and unto you your works; no argument between us and you. Allah will bring us together, and unto Him is the journeying

42:16.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآجُّونَ فِي ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ٱسۡتُجِيبَ لَهُۥ حُجَّتُهُمۡ دَاحِضَةٌ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبࣱ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدٌ
42:16.en: And those who argue concerning Allah after He hath been acknowledged, their argument hath no weight with their Lord, and wrath is upon them and theirs will be an awful doom

42:17.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۗ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبࣱ‏
42:17.en: Allah it is Who hath revealed the Scripture with truth, and the Balance. How canst thou know? It may be that the Hour is nigh

42:18.ar: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُ بِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهَاۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مُشۡفِقُونَ مِنۡهَا وَيَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّهَا ٱلۡحَقُّۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُمَارُونَ فِي ٱلسَّاعَةِ لَفِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدٍ
42:18.en: Those who believe not therein seek to hasten it, while those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the Truth. Are not they who dispute, in doubt concerning the Hour, far astray

42:19.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفُۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرۡزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡقَوِيُّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ
42:19.en: Allah is gracious unto His slaves. He provideth for whom He will. And He is the Strong, the Mighty

42:20.ar: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ نَزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِي حَرۡثِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ حَرۡثَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهِۦ مِنۡهَا وَمَا لَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِن نَّصِيبٍ
42:20.en: Whoso desireth the harvest of the Hereafter, We give him increase in its harvest. And whoso desireth the harvest of the world, We give him thereof, and he hath no portion in the Hereafter

42:21.ar: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَٰٓؤُاْ شَرَعُواْ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱلدِّينِ مَا لَمۡ يَأۡذَنۢ بِهِ ٱللَّهُۚ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
42:21.en: Or have they partners (of Allah) who have made lawful for them in religion that which Allah allowed not? And but for a decisive word (gone forth already), it would have been judged between them. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom

42:22.ar: تَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مُشۡفِقِينَ مِمَّا كَسَبُواْ وَهُوَ وَاقِعُۢ بِهِمۡۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِي رَوۡضَاتِ ٱلۡجَنَّاتِۖ لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَضۡلُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
42:22.en: Thou seest the wrong-doers fearful of that which they have earned, and it will surely befall them, while those who believe and do good works (will be) in flowering meadows of the Gardens, having what they wish from their Lord. This is the great preferment

42:23.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يُبَشِّرُ ٱللَّهُ عِبَادَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِۗ قُل لَّآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ أَجۡرًا إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوَدَّةَ فِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰۗ وَمَن يَقۡتَرِفۡ حَسَنَةࣰ نَّزِدۡ لَهُۥ فِيهَا حُسۡنًاۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ شَكُورٌ
42:23.en: This it is which Allah announceth unto His bondmen who believe and do good works. Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee therefor, save lovingkindness among kinsfolk. And whoso scoreth a good deed We add unto its good for him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Responsive

42:24.ar: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ اۖ فَإِن يَشَإِ ٱللَّهُ يَخۡتِمۡ عَلَىٰ قَلۡبِكَۗ وَيَمۡحُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَيُحِقُّ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
42:24.en: Or say they: He hath invented a lie concerning Allah? If Allah willed, He could have sealed thy heart (against them). And Allah will wipe out the lie and will vindicate the truth by His words. Lo! He is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men)

42:25.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
42:25.en: And He it is Who accepteth repentance from His bondmen, and pardoneth the evil deeds, and knoweth what ye do

42:26.ar: وَيَسۡتَجِيبُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَيَزِيدُهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦۚ وَٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدࣱ‏
42:26.en: And accepteth those who do good works, and giveth increase unto them of His bounty. And as for disbelievers, theirs will be an awful doom

42:27.ar: ۞وَلَوۡ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرࣲ مَّا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرُۢ بَصِيرࣱ‏
42:27.en: And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sendeth down by measure as He willeth. Lo! He is Informed, a Seer of His bondmen

42:28.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا قَنَطُواْ وَيَنشُرُ رَحۡمَتَهُۥۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡوَلِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ
42:28.en: And He it is Who sendeth down the saving rain after they have despaired, and spreadeth out His mercy. He is the Protecting Friend, the Praiseworthy

42:29.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا مِن دَآبَّةࣲۚ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ جَمۡعِهِمۡ إِذَا يَشَآءُ قَدِيرࣱ‏
42:29.en: And of His portents is the creation of the heaven and the earth, and of whatever beasts He hath dispersed therein. And He is Able to gather them when He will

42:30.ar: وَمَآ أَصَٰبَكُم مِّن مُّصِيبَةࣲ فَبِمَا كَسَبَتۡ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَيَعۡفُواْ عَن كَثِيرࣲ‏
42:30.en: Whatever of misfortune striketh you, it is what your right hands have earned. And He forgiveth much

42:31.ar: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيࣲّ وَلَا نَصِيرࣲ‏
42:31.en: Ye cannot escape in the earth, for beside Allah ye have no protecting friend nor any helper

42:32.ar: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِ ٱلۡجَوَارِ فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ كَٱلۡأَعۡلَٰمِ
42:32.en: And of His portents are the ships, like banners on the sea

42:33.ar: إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارࣲ شَكُورٍ
42:33.en: If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart)

42:34.ar: أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرࣲ‏
42:34.en: Or He causeth them to perish on account of that which they have earned - And He forgiveth much

42:35.ar: وَيَعۡلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصࣲ‏
42:35.en: And that those who argue concerning Our revelations may know they have no refuge

42:36.ar: فَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّن شَيۡءࣲ فَمَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
42:36.en: Now whatever ye have been given is but a passing comfort for the life of the world, and that which Allah hath is better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord

42:37.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ وَإِذَا مَا غَضِبُواْ هُمۡ يَغۡفِرُونَ
42:37.en: And those who shun the worst of sins and indecencies and, when they are wroth, forgive

42:38.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَجَابُواْ لِرَبِّهِمۡ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَمۡرُهُمۡ شُورَىٰ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
42:38.en: And those who answer the call of their Lord and establish worship, and whose affairs are a matter of counsel, and who spend of what We have bestowed on them

42:39.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَهُمُ ٱلۡبَغۡيُ هُمۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
42:39.en: And those who, when great wrong is done to them, defend themselves

42:40.ar: وَجَزَٰٓؤُاْ سَيِّئَةࣲ سَيِّئَةࣱ مِّثۡلُهَاۖ فَمَنۡ عَفَا وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَجۡرُهُۥ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
42:40.en: The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers

42:41.ar: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعۡدَ ظُلۡمِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
42:41.en: And whoso defendeth himself after he hath suffered wrong - for such, there is no way (of blame) against them

42:42.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظۡلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبۡغُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
42:42.en: The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom

42:43.ar: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
42:43.en: And verily whoso is patient and forgiveth - lo! that, verily, is (of) the steadfast heart of things

42:44.ar: وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِيࣲّ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلۡ إِلَىٰ مَرَدࣲّ مِّن سَبِيلࣲ‏
42:44.en: He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return

42:45.ar: وَتَرَىٰهُمۡ يُعۡرَضُونَ عَلَيۡهَا خَٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرۡفٍ خَفِيࣲّۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ ٱلۡخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيهِمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِي عَذَابࣲ مُّقِيمࣲ‏
42:45.en: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment

42:46.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
42:46.en: And they will have no protecting friends to help them instead of Allah. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no road

42:47.ar: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمࣱ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإࣲ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرࣲ‏
42:47.en: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal

42:48.ar: فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظًاۖ إِنۡ عَلَيۡكَ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ فَرِحَ بِهَاۖ وَإِن تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ كَفُورࣱ‏
42:48.en: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate

42:49.ar: لِّلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
42:49.en: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will

42:50.ar: أَوۡ يُزَوِّجُهُمۡ ذُكۡرَانࣰ ا وَإِنَٰثࣰ اۖ وَيَجۡعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمࣱ قَدِيرࣱ‏
42:50.en: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful

42:51.ar: ۞وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحۡيًا أَوۡ مِن وَرَآيِٕ حِجَابٍ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ رَسُولࣰ ا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذۡنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمࣱ‏
42:51.en: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise

42:52.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحࣰ ا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورࣰ ا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
42:52.en: And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path

42:53.ar: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
42:53.en: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last

43:2.en: By the Scripture which maketh plain

43:3.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
43:3.en: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand

43:4.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
43:4.en: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive

43:5.ar: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
43:5.en: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk

43:6.ar: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيࣲّ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
43:6.en: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old

43:7.ar: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
43:7.en: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him

43:8.ar: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
43:8.en: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them)

43:9.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
43:9.en: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them

43:10.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
43:10.en: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way

43:11.ar: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
43:11.en: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth

43:12.ar: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
43:12.en: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride

43:13.ar: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
43:13.en: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them)

43:14.en: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning

43:15.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًاۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورࣱ مُّبِينٌ
43:15.en: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate

43:16.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتࣲ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
43:16.en: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons

43:17.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلࣰ ا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدࣰّ ا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
43:17.en: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage

43:18.ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينࣲ‏
43:18.en: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain

43:19.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًاۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
43:19.en: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned

43:20.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُمۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
43:20.en: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess

43:21.ar: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبࣰ ا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
43:21.en: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto

43:22.ar: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
43:22.en: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints

43:23.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةࣲ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةࣲ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
43:23.en: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints

43:24.ar: ۞قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
43:24.en: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers

43:25.ar: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
43:25.en: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters

43:26.ar: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
43:26.en: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship

43:27.en: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me

43:28.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةࣰ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
43:28.en: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return

43:29.ar: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
43:29.en: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain

43:30.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرࣱ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
43:30.en: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein

43:31.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
43:31.en: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns

43:32.ar: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضࣲ دَرَجَٰتࣲ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضࣰ ا سُخۡرِيࣰّ اۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
43:32.en: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass

43:33.ar: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفࣰ ا مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
43:33.en: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount

43:34.ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبࣰ ا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
43:34.en: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline

43:35.ar: وَزُخۡرُفࣰ اۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
43:35.en: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil

43:36.ar: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنࣰ ا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينࣱ‏
43:36.en: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade

43:37.ar: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
43:37.en: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided

43:38.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
43:38.en: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade

43:39.ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
43:39.en: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom

43:40.ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
43:40.en: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest

43:41.ar: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
43:41.en: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them

43:42.ar: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
43:42.en: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them

43:43.ar: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
43:43.en: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path

43:44.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرࣱ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
43:44.en: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned

43:45.ar: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةࣰ يُعۡبَدُونَ
43:45.en: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent

43:46.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
43:46.en: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds

43:47.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
43:47.en: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them

43:48.ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَاۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
43:48.en: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again

43:49.ar: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
43:49.en: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright

43:50.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
43:50.en: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word

43:51.ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
43:51.en: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern

43:52.ar: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينࣱ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
43:52.en: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain

43:53.ar: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةࣱ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
43:53.en: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him

43:54.ar: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمࣰ ا فَٰسِقِينَ
43:54.en: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk

43:55.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
43:55.en: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one

43:56.ar: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفࣰ ا وَمَثَلࣰ ا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
43:56.en: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them)

43:57.ar: ۞وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
43:57.en: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out

43:58.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
43:58.en: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk

43:59.ar: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلࣰ ا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
43:59.en: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel

43:60.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
43:60.en: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth

43:61.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمࣱ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
43:61.en: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path

44:2.en: By the Scripture that maketh plain

44:3.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
44:3.en: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning

44:4.en: Whereon every wise command is made clear

44:5.ar: أَمۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
44:5.en: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending

44:6.ar: رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
44:6.en: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower

44:7.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
44:7.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure

44:8.ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
44:8.en: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

44:9.en: Nay, but they play in doubt

44:10.ar: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
44:10.en: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

44:11.en: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment

44:12.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
44:12.en: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers

44:13.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
44:13.en: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them

44:14.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
44:14.en: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman

44:15.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
44:15.en: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief)

44:16.ar: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
44:16.en: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish

44:17.ar: ۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
44:17.en: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger

44:18.ar: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ‏
44:18.en: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

44:19.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
44:19.en: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant

44:20.ar: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
44:20.en: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death

44:21.en: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go

44:22.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
44:22.en: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk

44:23.en: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed

44:24.ar: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
44:24.en: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host

44:25.en: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind

44:26.en: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

44:27.en: And pleasant things wherein they took delight

44:28.en: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk

44:29.ar: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
44:29.en: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

44:30.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
44:30.en: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom

44:31.ar: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
44:31.en: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones

44:32.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
44:32.en: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures

44:33.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
44:33.en: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial

44:35.ar: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
44:35.en: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again

44:36.en: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

44:37.ar: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
44:37.en: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty

44:38.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
44:38.en: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play

44:39.ar: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
44:39.en: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not

44:40.en: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them

44:41.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
44:41.en: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped

44:42.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
44:42.en: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful

44:45.en: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

44:46.en: As the seething of boiling water

44:47.en: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell

44:48.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
44:48.en: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water

44:49.en: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble

44:50.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
44:50.en: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt

44:51.en: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured

44:53.en: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another

44:54.en: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

44:55.en: They call therein for every fruit in safety

44:56.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
44:56.en: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell

44:57.ar: فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
44:57.en: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph

44:58.en: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed

44:59.en: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting

45:2.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
45:2.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

45:3.ar: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
45:3.en: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers

45:4.ar: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُوقِنُونَ
45:4.en: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure

45:5.ar: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقࣲ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَعۡقِلُونَ
45:5.en: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense

45:6.ar: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
45:6.en: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe

45:8.ar: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرࣰ ا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمࣲ‏
45:8.en: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom

45:9.ar: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱ‏
45:9.en: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom

45:10.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
45:10.en: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom

45:11.ar: هَٰذَا هُدࣰ ىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ
45:11.en: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath

45:12.ar: ۞ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
45:12.en: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful

45:13.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا مِّنۡهُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
45:13.en: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect

45:14.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
45:14.en: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn

45:15.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
45:15.en: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back

45:16.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
45:16.en: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples

45:17.ar: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
45:17.en: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ

45:18.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةࣲ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
45:18.en: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not

45:19.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضࣲۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
45:19.en: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil)

45:20.ar: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدࣰ ى وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يُوقِنُونَ
45:20.en: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure

45:21.ar: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءࣰ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
45:21.en: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment

45:22.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
45:22.en: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged

45:23.ar: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمࣲ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةࣰ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
45:23.en: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed

45:24.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
45:24.en: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess

45:25.ar: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
45:25.en: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful

45:26.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
45:26.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not

45:27.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
45:27.en: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost

45:28.ar: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةࣲ جَاثِيَةࣰۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةࣲ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
45:28.en: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do

43:62.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
43:62.en: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you

43:66.ar: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةࣰ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
43:66.en: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not

43:67.ar: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
43:67.en: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah)

43:68.ar: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
43:68.en: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve

43:69.en: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered

43:70.en: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad

43:71.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافࣲ مِّن ذَهَبࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
43:71.en: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein

43:72.ar: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
43:72.en: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do

43:73.ar: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ كَثِيرَةࣱ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
43:73.en: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat

43:74.ar: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
43:74.en: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment

43:75.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
43:75.en: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein

43:76.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
43:76.en: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong

43:77.ar: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
43:77.en: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain

43:78.ar: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
43:78.en: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth

43:79.ar: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرࣰ ا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
43:79.en: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining

43:80.ar: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
43:80.en: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record

43:81.ar: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدࣱ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
43:81.en: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son)

43:82.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
43:82.en: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)

43:89.ar: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمࣱۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
43:89.en: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know

6l3cU-ttNEs.speaker: adnan
6l3cU-ttNEs.speaker_note: his A Juz A Day series; welcomes viewers and recaps the previous night in his own voice
6l3cU-ttNEs.title: A Juz A Day: 25th Juz - The Ha Meems
6l3cU-ttNEs.one_line: End of Fussilat through Ash-Shura, Az-Zukhruf, Ad-Dukhan and Al-Jathiyah: how a persecuted minority keeps inviting to Allah with patience, unity and forgiveness.
6l3cU-ttNEs.summary: He reads the 25th juz as a manual for dawah by a persecuted minority, since these Ha Meem surahs came down while the Muslims of Makkah were weak but on the truth. From Fussilat he draws the angels' promise to the steadfast at death and the command to repel evil with what is best: push back to protect your dignity, but without vengeance and wishing the other person good, until enemies become friends. He explains why the Quran had to be in the Prophet's language, while stressing that language is never the real cause of belief or rejection. In Ash-Shura he dwells on unity: earlier communities split out of envy after knowledge came, which made later generations doubt the message, and Muslims have fallen into the same trap. He lists the believers' traits that give the surah its name, especially consultation and forgiving when angry, and ranks pardon above even rightful justice. Az-Zukhruf becomes a critique of materialism: contempt for daughters, blind loyalty to forefathers, and Allah's statement that He could give disbelievers silver roofs because wealth proves nothing. Ad-Dukhan and Al-Jathiyah return to Musa, Laylat al-Qadr, and the person who takes desire as his god. Throughout he asks believers to keep inviting, stay united, and leave the results to Allah.

outline.heading: Opening
The Ha Meems as dawah from a persecuted minority
outline.gist: Five of the seven Ha Meem surahs fall in this juz; they were revealed when Muslims were a persecuted minority, and he recaps the believer of Pharaoh's household and the opening of Fussilat.

outline.heading: Quraysh try to drown out the Quran
outline.gist: The disbelievers urge each other not to listen and to make noise over it; Allah tells the Prophet to keep going because the Quran will not be drowned out.

outline.heading: Angels descend on those who stay steadfast
outline.gist: Those who say their Lord is Allah and remain firm are told at death not to fear or grieve and are given the glad tidings of paradise.

outline.heading: Do not stoop to the level of those who insult you
outline.gist: Dawah brings insults and persecution, but believers must not drag themselves down to the attacker's level.

outline.heading: Repel evil with what is best
outline.gist: Defend yourself and your dignity, but truthfully, without vengeance and wanting good for the other; with patience an enemy can become a close friend.

outline.heading: Seek refuge when Shaytan provokes you
outline.gist: Shaytan tries to make us slip into a harsh reply, so seeking refuge in Allah is the protection.

outline.heading: Nothing is said to you but what was said to earlier messengers
outline.gist: Every prophet faced the same hurtful words; Allah forgives those who stop and punishes those who persist.

outline.heading: Why the Quran is in Arabic, and why language is not the issue
outline.gist: A prophet speaks his people's language, so the revelation had to be Arabic; yet the Torah in Hebrew was still disputed, fluent Arabs rejected the Quran, and non-Arabs embrace it as guidance and healing.

outline.heading: Knowledge of the Hour belongs to Allah alone
outline.gist: No fruit or pregnancy escapes His knowledge; on that day the associates are disowned by those who worshipped them.

outline.heading: The fickle human in ease and hardship
outline.gist: People despair when touched by evil and grow arrogant when relieved, claiming they deserved it.

outline.heading: Signs in the horizons and in themselves
outline.gist: Allah will show His signs in the universe and within people until it is clear the Quran is the truth.

outline.heading: Ash-Shura opens: the heavens nearly burst in awe
outline.gist: The majesty of creation, and angels seeking forgiveness for those on earth, point to the majesty of the Creator and of the Quran.

outline.heading: Warn the mother of cities
outline.gist: Makkah was the Prophet's first audience, which is why the Quran addresses its people's beliefs in detail, while the rest of humanity is also addressed.

outline.heading: Nothing is like Him; He holds the keys of provision
outline.gist: Allah made mates for people and cattle, and gives provision as He wills, which is no sign of His pleasure or displeasure.

outline.heading: One religion from Nuh to Muhammad: uphold it without division
outline.gist: The same way was ordained for Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa and Isa; the polytheists found this unbearable; Allah chooses and guides whoever turns to Him.

outline.heading: Division out of envy after knowledge came
outline.gist: Followers of earlier prophets split into sects not over legitimate interpretation but out of rivalry, which led later generations to doubt the scripture; Muslims fell into the same trap.

outline.heading: Keep inviting and stay steadfast as commanded
outline.gist: You cannot control people's disputes; believe in every scripture, judge fairly, and leave the gathering to Allah.

outline.heading: The harvest of the hereafter versus the harvest of this world
outline.gist: Whoever seeks the next life is increased in it; whoever seeks only this world gets some of it and nothing after, a principle urgent in a materialistic age.

outline.heading: No payment asked, only kinship; the door of tawbah is open
outline.gist: The Prophet asks only that family ties be honoured; the fabrication charge hides fear of losing status, while Allah accepts repentance and increases the believers.

outline.heading: Provision in measure keeps people grounded
outline.gist: If everyone had abundant provision they would transgress; needing to earn keeps society functioning, and Allah sends rain after despair.

outline.heading: Affliction comes from your own hands, and He pardons much
outline.gist: Allah overlooks most of our mistakes, but that does not mean anyone can escape Him.

outline.heading: Ships like mountains and a world brought to a standstill
outline.gist: Shipping brings prosperity and exchange, yet Allah can still the wind; the pandemic showed how all our progress can stop if He wills.

outline.heading: Traits of those who trust their Lord
outline.gist: They avoid major sins and shameful deeds, forgive when angry, establish prayer, spend, and seek justice rather than being doormats.

outline.heading: Consultation: the name of the surah
outline.gist: Lasting work and dawah are teamwork; a healthy community lets everyone's opinion be heard.

outline.heading: Justice is your right, forgiveness is higher
outline.gist: You may seek equal redress and no one can blame you, but not exceed it; patiently pardoning puts you at a higher level than winning your due.

outline.heading: Respond to your Lord before the day that cannot be averted
outline.gist: The Prophet is only to deliver the message, not to police people, who listen in hardship and walk away in ease.

outline.heading: He gives daughters, sons, both, or none
outline.gist: Children are entirely Allah's choice; no one decides whether they have a son, a daughter or none.

outline.heading: Allah alone chooses who receives revelation
outline.gist: Just as you have no say over your children, you have no say over who becomes a prophet; revelation comes by inspiration, from behind a veil or through an angel.

outline.heading: Az-Zukhruf: an understudied surah for a materialistic age
outline.gist: He presents the surah as speaking directly to our materialism and notes the Ha Meem pattern of opening with the Quran.

outline.heading: Pathways, rain, pairs and mounts
outline.gist: Natural paths, measured rain and subjected animals are blessings that link creation to resurrection and should prompt gratitude.

outline.heading: Making part of His creation a share of Him
outline.gist: Despite these blessings the pagans associated parts of creation with Allah, an act of ingratitude.

outline.heading: Rage at the birth of a daughter
outline.gist: The pagans attributed daughters to Allah while resenting their own as unprofitable; children are not assets for net worth, each holds hidden blessing.

outline.heading: Calling the angels female
outline.gist: Allah asks whether they witnessed the angels' creation or have any scripture; their claim is recorded and they will be questioned.

outline.heading: We found our forefathers on a way
outline.gist: Their real reason was inherited culture; every spoiled elite answered prophets the same way, even when offered something better.

outline.heading: Ibrahim's enduring declaration and Makkah's luxury
outline.gist: Ibrahim's descendants kept his words yet set up idols, mistaking their wealth and privilege for Allah's approval.

outline.heading: Why not a great man from the two cities
outline.gist: Quraysh wanted a rich, important prophet; Allah asks whether they distribute His mercy when they do not even control livelihoods.

outline.heading: Silver roofs and gold ornaments
outline.gist: Allah could give disbelievers every luxury were it not for the fitnah; it is fleeting, and the hereafter is for the mindful.

outline.heading: Three lessons of the passage
outline.gist: Wealth and prophethood are Allah's choice and no sign of approval; Ibrahim's descendants left his way; materialism leads nowhere.

outline.heading: You cannot make the deaf hear: hold firm to the revelation
outline.gist: Whether or not the Prophet lives to see the outcome, he must focus on what is in his control and know he is on the straight path.

outline.heading: Musa's signs and Pharaoh's broken promises
outline.gist: Each sign was greater than the last, yet they mocked and broke their word once relief came.

outline.heading: Pharaoh's boast mirrors Quraysh
outline.gist: Pharaoh asked why Musa had no gold bracelets, the same reasoning Quraysh used about an orphan prophet without wealth.

outline.heading: The son of Mary as a debating point
outline.gist: Quraysh cited Isa only to argue, not out of interest in his message; he was a servant favoured as an example.

outline.heading: The return of Isa as a sign of the Hour
outline.gist: Isa will come back as a follower of the Prophet, and his return signals that the Day of Judgment is near.

outline.heading: Friends become enemies except the righteous
outline.gist: Close friends turn on each other on that day except the God-conscious, who enter paradise with their spouses rejoicing.

outline.heading: The people of the fire call on Malik
outline.gist: They beg to be finished off and are told they will remain; Allah hears their secret plotting and angels record it.

outline.heading: If the Most Compassionate had a son
outline.gist: The Prophet would be the first to worship it, but Allah is far above being contained in His creation.

outline.heading: Turn away and say peace
outline.gist: The Prophet is told to turn the page on ridicule; replying drags you into the mud, while peaceful restraint opens observers' hearts and shows true character.

outline.heading: Ad-Dukhan: sent down on a blessed night
outline.gist: Every wise matter is decreed on Laylat al-Qadr, a night when dua can change the direction of a life.

outline.heading: The day of the visible smoke
outline.gist: When the haze overwhelms them they claim belief, but it is too late; they had called the Prophet a madman taught by others.

outline.heading: Musa the noble messenger and the parted sea
outline.gist: Musa asks for the servants of Allah, leaves by night, and is told to leave the sea parted because Pharaoh's army is to drown.

outline.heading: Neither heaven nor earth wept for them
outline.gist: The Quran answers an Egyptian belief that the sky and earth weep for a dead pharaoh, something only confirmed after the hieroglyphs were deciphered.

outline.heading: The tree of zaqqum: taste it, mighty one
outline.gist: Quraysh are warned that, like Pharaoh, they will be finished; the arrogant are mocked with their own self-image in the fire.

outline.heading: The righteous in security, tasting no death after the first
outline.gist: Gardens, springs and serenity; after the first death there is no more death or pain.

outline.heading: Al-Jathiyah: signs in creation tied to signs in the book
outline.gist: The heavens, living beings, night and day, rain and winds are signs, linked again to the verses of the Quran.

outline.heading: Bani Israel differed out of envy; do not be disunited
outline.gist: The same lesson as Ash-Shura: disunity came from jealousy, so follow the clear way and not the desires of those without knowledge.

outline.heading: Taking one's desire as a god; only time destroys us
outline.gist: Those who say life is just birth and death have no knowledge, only speculation; Allah gives life and death and will gather all.

outline.heading: Every community on its knees
outline.gist: On the Day of Judgment each faith community kneels to be called to its record, which gives the surah its name.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.label: Dawah, outreach and representing Islam
themes.note: The Ha Meems teach a persecuted minority how to keep inviting despite insults, without stooping and leaving results to Allah.

themes.label: Mercy, forgiveness and pardoning people
themes.note: Repel evil with what is best: protect your dignity without vengeance and wish good for the one who wronged you.

themes.label: Justice and refusing oppression
themes.note: Seeking equal redress is a right that no one may blame, but pardon is the higher station.

themes.label: Unity of the ummah
themes.note: Earlier communities split out of envy rather than honest interpretation, causing later generations to doubt; Muslims repeated it.

themes.label: Community building, cooperation and the ummah
themes.note: Consultation and teamwork make dawah and any lasting work possible and keep a community healthy.

themes.label: Wealth, asceticism (zuhd), consumerism and money
themes.note: Wealth and luxury prove nothing about Allah's approval; Az-Zukhruf speaks to our materialistic society.

themes.label: Gender relations, chastity and modesty
themes.note: Resenting daughters as unprofitable is incoherent; every child carries a blessing that investment unlocks.

themes.label: Relationship with the Quran: reading, reflecting, living it
themes.note: The Quran is guidance and healing for believers whatever language they speak; Arabic is no excuse either way.

themes.label: The Hereafter: resurrection, judgment, paradise, hellfire
